author: izjust4fun
body:
Hey guys here is mine and Crazy_Clownz's newest walls map, Tetris Snow! It's another map from the Tetris Walls Series.

It's a winter themed map, there are plenty of hidden easter eggs and interesting places to go and explore! It's probably best to download the map and check it out for yourself :)

We hope you like it!

Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/7464hy6llpb7ib3/Tetris_Snow.zip

Pics: http://imgur.com/a/762FT

YML: http://pastebin.com/1WBJrCgJ
